[EN] {@Rgn:48005} houses a huge number of argon troops. We need to take out some of their primary operators—iknephar prelates and kalash sentinels.

This is a straightforward strike mission. Get in there and "hammer 'em," as the amani say.
[ES] {@Rgn:48005} alberga a una gran cantidad de tropas argon. Necesitamos eliminar a algunos de sus operadores principales: iknephar prelates y kalash sentinels.

Esta es una misión de ataque directa. Entra y "dale duro", como dicen los amani.

[EN] Your attack weakened their hold. Hopefully, the Shariar can take advantage of it.

We're stronger for your service, . Well done.
[ES] Tu ataque debilitó su control. Con suerte, los Shariar podrán sacar provecho de ello.

Somos más fuertes gracias a tu servicio, . Bien hecho.
